description: Finish a Buyer Assurance check: GAIP replays the public service (or checks a response you submit) against the terms from assurance_prepare and returns a delivery receipt. Free, no account, no effect outside GAIP: the call records a receipt in GAIP's history. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).
name: assurance_complete
title: Complete a buyer-side delivery check
